description:
Session 01a07292 repeatedly collided with the shared test lock and confused agent-write-preflight, optional pre-push checks, and full pr-preflight. Extend tests/conftest.py's existing flock and Make targets; do not add another lock service. Reuse local results only to avoid a duplicate invocation with identical command and complete input identity, never to satisfy hosted required checks or reuse evidence across changed integration trees.

FEATURE-BATCH EXTENSION: receipts may coalesce only identical validated inputs. Member preparation evidence never certifies the later integrated tree. Include member base/head, scope/config identity and integration content in invalidation; conflict edits and changed predecessor content invalidate affected member and downstream contracts. Account for worker plus integration checks in the same frozen feature delivery record; do not omit pre-PR checks when reporting savings.

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a snapshot, a queued review, a skipped hook or an unbound passing check as completion
anti_patterns.instead: Bind actual evidence to the relevant PR/head/input and retain an explicit owned next action
anti_patterns.why: The observed session repeatedly lost asynchronous work or overstated evidence

preserves.behavior: KEEP_IDLE and SHADOW_ONLY remain in force for skip/shard/demotion/reduced-refresh proposals; this plan does not activate them.
Keep GitHub native merge queue as the only merger; no privileged steward, bypass actor, direct protected-branch push, or new bot credential.
Preserve required PR, merge_group, and post-merge coverage, soundness maintainer review, explicit user authority, and durable hold labels.

prior_art.concept: Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority
Existing implementation or governing evidence to extend without a parallel authority

verifications.description: Local validation preserves lock safety and evidence identity
verifications.expected: exit 0; behavioral negative controls fail on the prior implementation

work_units.notes: Measure lock refusals, actual command counts and local gate wall time before changes using the existing session/metric evidence. Define one ordered focused-check then required-preflight path and explicit actual gate names; hooks that do no work report skipped, never tested/passed.
work_units.summary: Measure duplicate gate work and define exact gate reporting

work_units.notes: Extend the existing lock acquisition with bounded waiting, owner/progress visibility, cancellation and timeout behavior. Do not delete active locks, bypass CPU protection, spawn concurrent xdist suites, or add another cross-process lock authority.
work_units.summary: Add bounded owner-aware waiting to the existing test lock

work_units.notes: Coalesce duplicate same-input gate requests using a completed local receipt bound to working-tree content (including relevant untracked files), base/input SHAs, command, config, lockfile/tool versions and exit status. Unknown identity, changed files/ref/tool, incomplete/cancelled run or different gate requires execution. Never reuse cross-tree or hosted certification.
work_units.summary: Coalesce duplicate same-input local checks using complete evidence identities

work_units.notes: Test two worktrees, timeout/cancel, dead owner, changed HEAD/base/untracked input/tool, skipped hooks, failed prior run and successful identical request. Measure after: one actual execution for simultaneous identical requests, no repeated lock-error retry loop, no lost gate coverage, and bounded added waiting.
work_units.summary: Verify contention, invalidation, failure and skipped-hook behavior and measure savings
Verify batch member and combined-tree receipt invalidation without hiding pre-PR effort
